📷 Photo Bank
How to use:
1. Tap Camera or Gallery to add photos
2. On each photo tap Assign to point, pick the inspection point from the full list, then mark it OK or Issue
3. Tap Apply & Close — photos and the OK/Issue result are added to the inspection points

Settings

Company on reports

Kept on this phone only. Change any time; new and reopened reports use it.

Default report style

Your signature

Sign once. It is placed on every report automatically. It stays on this phone and is never sent to the workshop or any server.

Display

Large-touch mode
Bigger buttons and text throughout, for gloved hands and bright sunlight.
Show time on report
Off shows the date only. On adds the clock time. You can still switch this per report.

Issue notes

Write issue notes for me
When you mark a point as Issue, a short professional note is written for it. You can always edit it.
Note length
The app learns your wording when you edit a note.

Photos

Save camera photos to the device
Every shot from the in-app camera is also written out, named after the plate.
Save method
Download is silent and lands in your Downloads folder. Share sheet takes one tap per photo but lets you choose “Save to Photos”, which is the only route to the camera roll on iPhone.
This browser cannot share files, so Download will be used.
Imported photo size
Photos picked from the gallery are resized before they are stored. Smaller sizes keep reports fast and save space. Camera shots are already compressed.

Select Report Format
Choose how you want the report to look. Tap one to set as default.
C
Compact
One page. Each issue with its finding, action, priority and photos in one table. Company logo, result and your signature.
A
Audit form
Findings table, section summary, then a photo page with numbered figures. Sign-off at the end.
C
Cards
Coloured result banner and one card per issue with its photo beside it. Easy for drivers and supervisors.
F
Full checklist
Every point listed as OK or Issue, then findings and photos. Best as audit evidence.
